summary: These headlines touch on several distinct local matters—a judicial recusal request in a parks case, investigations involving the Kennedy Center, concerns about National Guard deployment at schools, and economic analysis of worker wage gains—alongside a demographic comparison noting D.C.'s population relative to some states. The stories do not form a coherent narrative around a single statehood or governance issue. Without statehood, Congress reviews the District's laws and can vote to repeal them.
